main_text.l: Bellum Alanis qui Mallagetæ, Pharasmanes mo-
vastavit. Multamen Alani seu Vologæsi mune-
rib[us] ... Flavii Arriani Cappadociæ præfecti merunt
De AFRICA non habeo, quod scribam:
præter id, quod de reliquiis Pompeji sepulchro
Quem excepit Ericus, Sivardi ex filia nepos,
à Granio Severo exstructum est quod sa-
dam maritus vix evasit, comprehensum medi-cum.
Armenia per LXXXM palluum, quidem Rotoma-
gus dividere, duxit, qui valde sinceram [illegible, ~3 letters].

page.notes: Left margin notes are largely illegible. Right margin notes read approximately "Asiatica", "Africa", "Europa", "Spartianus", "Adriano", "Mart. in Hist. Aug." and "Maur. Gallus"; the scan is faint and damaged, so these are uncertain. Many words in the body are doubtful, especially near the left edge and in the lower paragraphs, and several lines are partly obscured by show-through. Transcription is approximate where marked by context.
